bio: Charles Booker is now divorced, a father of two daughters, and a lifelong Kentuckian. He grew up in West Louisville in a family that worked hard and still came up short, where the electricity got cut off, where dinner sometimes meant deciding who ate, and where the insulin his family needed had to be rationed to make it last.
